name: registerCniConfiguration
description: Register a CNI Configuration to be used with CKS cluster

params.name: account
params.description: an optional account for the user data. Must be used with domainId.

params.name: domainid
params.description: an optional domainId for the user data. If the account parameter is used, domainId must also be used.

params.name: projectid
params.description: an optional project for the user data

params.name: cniconfig
params.description: Base64 encoded CNI content. Nonempty text and binary content are supported. The canonical encoded size is limited by vm.userdata.max.length and the HTTP limit (4 KiB for GET, 1 MiB for POST).

params.name: params
params.description: comma separated list of variables declared in user data content

response.name: jobstatus
response.description: The current status of the latest async job acting on this object

response.name: domainpath
response.description: Path of the domain to which the User Data owner belongs

response.name: domainid
response.description: The domain id of the User Data owner

response.name: jobid
response.description: The UUID of the latest async job acting on this object

response.name: accountid
response.description: The owner id of the User Data

response.name: projectid
response.description: The project id of the User Data

response.name: hasannotations
response.description: True if the entity/resource has annotations

response.name: account
response.description: The owner of the User Data

response.name: params
response.description: List of parameters which contains the list of keys or string parameters that are needed to be passed for any variables declared in the User Data

response.name: domain
response.description: The domain name of the User Data owner

response.name: project
response.description: The project name of the User Data
